mechanism_narrative: A rise in GDP indicates increased economic activity, leading to higher demand for goods and services, which in turn drives up stock prices, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher during periods of GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing and spending, which drives up stock prices, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher when the federal funds rate is below 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate above 9% indicates a weakening labor market, leading to decreased consumer spending and lower stock prices, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower when the unemployment rate is above 9% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production indicates increased economic activity, leading to higher demand for goods and services, which in turn drives up stock prices, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher during periods of industrial production growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts indicates decreased demand for housing, leading to lower economic activity, which in turn drives down stock prices, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower when housing starts are below 500 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate above 4% and a decrease in the consumer price index below 2% indicate a tightening monetary policy and low inflation, leading to increased borrowing costs and lower stock prices, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower when the federal funds rate is above 4% and the consumer price index is below 2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment above 200,000 and a decrease in the unemployment rate below 6% indicate a strong labor market, leading to increased consumer spending and higher stock prices, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher when payroll employment is above 200,000 and the unemployment rate is below 6% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail sales below $300 billion indicates decreased consumer spending, leading to lower economic activity, which in turn drives down stock prices, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower when retail sales are below $300 billion (t-test p > 0.05).
